meta.title: PromptShield: Deployable Detection for Prompt Injection Attacks

problem.v: Existing injection detectors have too many false positives for deployment
problem.q: deployable prompt injection detector needs to have an extremely low false positive rate

main_idea.v: Benchmark of conversational and application-structured data + fine-tuned detector evaluated at low-FPR thresholds

threat_model.v: Detector monitors all inputs to an LLM-integrated app; adversary controls part of processed data

injection_types_covered.name: Injection attacks incl. HackAPrompt and FourAttacks sets

metrics.name: AUC, TPR at fixed FPR (1%, 0.5%, 0.1%, 0.05%)
metrics.definition: deployment scheme picks thresholds at target FPR

results.claim: PromptShield Llama-3.1-8B vs DeBERTa-184M vs PromptGuard (TPR@FPR1%)

limitations_stated.v: Decision threshold was calibrated on test data instead of validation split
limitations_stated.q: we should have used the validation split for this calibration step

limitations_inferred: [INFERENCE] 8B detector is too heavy for CPU-only; 184M DeBERTa variant is the feasible one for us

reusable_for_our_project.v: Reuse as (a) defense baseline (public detectors e.g. ProtectAI DeBERTa v2 on HF, p11 ref) and (b) benchmark prompts for evaluation; report TPR@low-FPR for our defense
